user.title: Import Hydro One Green Button XML
user.description: Enter the absolute path to a Green Button XML file already accessible to Home Assistant. Example: {example_path}. Place the file in your configuration directory first.

error.file_not_found: The file was not found. Check the path and make sure the file is on the Home Assistant system.
error.permission_denied: Home Assistant does not have permission to read this file.
error.invalid_file: The file could not be parsed as a supported Green Button XML usage export.

abort.already_configured: This file path is already configured.
